title: China reverse engineering downed craft

tellings.quote: we know for a fact they are working on reverse engineering they have down craft

plain: China has crashed craft of unknown origin and is working to reverse engineer them, meaning take them apart to learn how they work. That is what the researcher Bob Maguire tells Michels, saying "we know for a fact" but naming no source. If true, it would mean the US is not the only country trying to copy recovered craft.
